title: Lanthanide coordination complexes framed by sodium ions: slow relaxation of the magnetization in the Dy(III) derivative

material_class.structural_family: Ln4Na2 zig-zag tetranuclear lanthanide cluster with coordinated sodium ions

synthesis.procedure: All family members were prepared by the same protocol. One equivalent (0.5 mmol) of Ln(NO3)3·xH2O or LnCl3·xH2O (Ln = Dy; x = 5 or 6) was dissolved in 10 mL DMF, then one equivalent of H3L (0.5 mmol, 0.11 g) was added to give a bright red solution. After stirring ca. 30 min, a solution of NaOAc (5 equiv., 2.5 mmol, 0.34 g) in ca. 5 mL MeOH was added, lightening the colour. After 2–3 min stirring the mixture was filtered into a glass vial and left for slow evaporation of MeOH. Yellow irregular X-ray quality crystals formed after 5–7 days, were vacuum-filtered, and washed with small amounts of DMF and diethyl ether.

reagents.name: sodium acetate
reagents.role: base, acetate coligand, and Na+ source

synthesis.time: stir ca. 30 min, then 2–3 min after acetate addition; crystals after 5–7 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly in DMF/MeOH; filtration into a glass vial; slow evaporation of MeOH
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered through paper into a glass vial; slow evaporation of MeOH afforded yellow irregular crystals; vacuum-filtered and washed with DMF and diethyl ether
synthesis.yield: generally low, 10–20% based on Ln (varies among Ln(III) ions); EA found (calcd) C 40.53 (40.96), H 3.97 (4.64), N 7.36 (7.78)%

properties.summary: Field-induced SMM behaviour. Room-temperature χMT = 54.58 cm3 K mol−1 (1000 Oe). χMT decreases on cooling due to mJ depopulation; intramolecular Ln–Ln exchange is negligible. Zero-field ac χ″ shows only an onset at 1.9 K (1488 Hz). Under 2000 Oe, two relaxation processes appear (1.9–6.9 K). Slow-process Arrhenius fit gives Δ = 43(1) K and τ0 = 2×10−6 s, but τ(T) is better described by a direct plus Raman model (D = 52 s−1 K−1, C = 0.0049 s−1 K−6).
